equations.pattern: Legendre n=0 and n=1 dropped. Bending kappa = -d^2(w)/dphi^2/R^2 on the n=2..6 reconstruction, w = R*alpha*T.

properties_QUESTIONABLE.Be_sources: E, nu and the 345/379.2 MPa endpoints are the 028b SR-200 values. Alpha 11.3e-6 is the Materion S-200-F class reported in the OSTI grade survey, not a separate SR-200 coupon.
properties_QUESTIONABLE.optical_note: Coated pair is the 016 white-coating band. Bare emittance is an engineering stand-in for a polished metal with high infrared reflectance. Materion quotes 98.5 percent reflectance at 8 to 12 micrometres for beryllium; 0.05 is broader than that band.
properties_QUESTIONABLE.air: T 284.9 K, mu 1.79e-5, k 0.0257, Pr 0.71, Whitaker sphere and Churchill-Bernstein cylinder
properties_QUESTIONABLE.frame_and_film: SiC 410 GPa, 4.5e-6; Ti-6Al-4V 113.8 GPa, 8.6e-6; CFRP 150 GPa, 0.5e-6; Mylar 4.8 GPa, 17e-6; Kapton 2.5 GPa, 20e-6; Zylon 180 GPa, -6e-6. Projection film unstated.

wind_source: FAA-P-8110-2 CHG 2, paragraphs 3.6, 3.9 and 3.25 Table 4. Gusts 25 ft/s at VH and 35 ft/s at VB. VB at least 35 knots. Table 4 symmetrical mooring 70 knots. The change narrative says the requirement discussed was 78 knots.
